name: aem-assets-deep-content-search-and-upload
description: AEM DAM deep content search (text rendition semantic search) and proper binary upload with versioning support for AEM as a Cloud Service.
author: KM Robin

skills.name: aem-assets-deep-content-search
skills.description: Search inside document content (PDF/DOCX body text) using text renditions when AEM metadata search returns no results. Automatically falls back to fetching cqdam.text.txt renditions and applying AI semantic matching.

skills.name: aem-assets-upload-versioning
skills.description: Upload files to AEM DAM using the correct 3-step Cloud Service binary upload protocol (initiateUpload → blob PUT → completeUpload). Supports both new asset creation and versioning existing assets with labels and comments.
